name: Tyres & regen
about: The built-in car (pack, motors, tyre pressures, drive and regen flow) as one layer, with your own text and charge bar beside it.

layers.name: Tyres
layers.text: =!known(tyre_fl) ? 'Tyres: no reading' : min(tyre_fl, tyre_fr, tyre_rl, tyre_rr) < tyre_low_bar ? 'Check tyres · lowest ' + tyre(min(tyre_fl, tyre_fr, tyre_rl, tyre_rr)) + ' ' + tyre_unit : 'Tyres OK · battery ' + fmt(soc) + '%'
layers.color: =known(tyre_fl) && min(tyre_fl, tyre_fr, tyre_rl, tyre_rr) < tyre_low_bar ? warn : text2
